notes.title: VERSION 1.0 - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
It's been a wild ride. One year became two, two became four, and now we're here- my first completed game on Steam. To everyone who has supported the team and the project over the course of development, thank you! We hope you enjoy the content in this latest update.

Where do we go from here? 1.0 will not likely be the absolute last update. There will still be room for bug fixes and possibly further content updates. I would not expect anything drastic or large, but we have no intentions on letting ATU languish now that it's released. We will be keeping an eye on player feedback and revisiting as necessary!

Our main focus going forward will be on our new project, Sugar Service. We hope to eventually bring that one to Steam as well, but as it is a new project and a spiritual successor to A Town Uncovered, it is still in early stages for the time being. 

Without further ado, here are the contents of the 1.0 update!
